document: ET-8b — seed 89: a GATED, DISJOINTNESS-CHECKED, UNUSED 300. NOT the set 理 ruled for the accumulation run (that is seed 73); kept as the virgin alternative.
why: docs/et8b-reading-note.md: the accumulation limb was evaluated on 75 held-out tasks with an 18.7-point interval, which cannot separate §4's one-shot reading from a small real increment. §4 asks for an independent 300. This is that set, prepared so the decision to spend it is not conditioned on the screen's direction.

gates_at_generation.verdict: GATE PASS — gen refuses to write otherwise

vs_tasks_v3_seed21.note: 71 symptom strings appear in both sets. Different seeds do not guarantee different symptoms, and a shared symptom is a leakage path that P3 only tests WITHIN a set.

CROSS_SET_P3_the_test_the_shared_symptom.instrument: build the symptom -> bug_region lookup table on v3 (seed 21) and apply it to seed 89 — the table a leaker would have
CROSS_SET_P3_the_test_the_shared_symptom.verdict: BELOW CHANCE. A symptom table learned on v3 actively fails on seed 89, so the 71 shared symptom strings carry no region information across the sets.

STILL_PROVISIONAL: P4 runs on the EMITTED set and needs a base arm's outcome spread. Until a base run reports it, this set is gated but not validated — the same status every v3 set has before its base arm.
status: PREPARED AND STANDING BY. No arm has run on it. 理 rules whether it is spent.

⚠️_STATUS_CORRECTION_2026-09-21.what_理_should_know_about_the_named_seeds: both seed 47 (tasks/v3rep) and seed 73 (tasks/v3c) already carry full base+G arms from 8a's R3 (commit 1c1c8f0, results/r3_complete.json): +14.0 [+8.3,+19.7] and +13.3 [+8.0,+18.7] for the single-decision head. It does mean the set accumulates reuse across papers. Raised in nirai 11729; 理 proceeded.
